title: OpenReadingResponse

BBox.description: CANONICAL geometry: top-left origin, y increases downward, normalized to [0,1] relative to the containing page's width/height. This is the ONE convention the normalizer emits (see §6.1). Absolute coordinates are recoverable via page.width/page.height/page.unit. Raw source geometry is preserved in bbox_native. (C8 bbox.canonical.)

polygon.description: Optional 4+ corner points, same normalized top-left space. Present when source gives a polygon (Textract, Azure, DocAI, unstructured, Marker/Surya).

bbox_native.description: Raw source geometry, untouched, for round-trip fidelity.

dpi.description: Set when unit=pixel and geometry is dpi-dependent (pytesseract, Mistral, rasterized OCR).

Block.description: One reading-order element. `type` is the normalized enum; `native_type` preserves the backend's own label.

type.description: Normalized down from each backend's own vocabulary; unmapped types → 'other' with native_type retained.

native_type.description: Backend's own label, verbatim: Textract 'KEY_VALUE_SET', unstructured 'NarrativeText', dots-ocr 'Section-header', Chunkr segment_type, Docling label.

text.description: Plain text of the element (assembled if the backend only gives sub-word units). C1 text.plain + C2 text.complete: plain UTF-8, no markup, and table content is included here as tab-joined rows.

markdown.description: Per-element markdown/HTML when the backend renders it (Chunkr segment.content, Reducto block content, LlamaParse item.md, MinerU table_body HTML). C3 markdown.gfm: parses as GFM; literal content escaped.

html.description: Table HTML when provided (unstructured text_as_html, Azure, MinerU, Marker, dots-ocr Table text).

confidence.description: Normalized to [0,1]. Textract 0-100 → /100. Absent for deterministic parsers (pymupdf/pdfplumber/pdfminer), markdown-only outputs, and token-stream LLMs (see §6.4). C7 confidence.unit: float in [0,1].

reading_order.description: 0-based index in reading order when the backend establishes one.

table.description: Populated only when type=table. C-table (§4.7): the canonical grid; grid coordinates are true positions under merged cells (occupancy-cursor rule); is_header comes from provider signals, never fabricated as row 0.

rows.description: Lowest-common-denominator list-of-lists (pymupdf Table.extract(), pdfplumber, camelot). Nulls for empty cells.

children.description: Ids of child blocks when a hierarchy is preserved (Textract CHILD relationships, Docling groups, DocAI). Flattened output keeps this optional edge list; consumers who only want the flat list ignore it.

text_type.description: Textract TextType; Azure styles[].isHandwritten. Unknown for backends that don't distinguish.

SchemaCheck.description: How the returned typed_fields measure up against the request's extraction schema. The check reports and never acts: it changes no status, no route and no value. Computed by openreading.derive.fields.check_typed_fields.

schema_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) of the schema as sent, x-read-* annotations included. Two checks with the same hash ran against the same schema.

schema_ref.description: The shipped schema this one is, such as bank:bank_statement@v1. Null for a schema you supplied.

valid.description: True when the returned values, with null object keys omitted, validate against the schema with no error.

critical_ok.description: True when no field labelled x-read-criticality: critical is missing or invalid.

fields.description: One entry per top-level property, plus one per nested property that carries its own x-read-criticality. A column inside array items is reported once, at its path without an index.

criticality.description: The x-read-criticality label, or expected when the property carries none.

status.description: missing: absent, null or a blank string. invalid: present with a validation error at or below the path. Missing beats invalid.

extra.description: Returned top-level typed_fields keys the schema does not declare, sorted. They stay in typed_fields.

errors.description: Up to 50 validation errors in the validator's order.

path.description: Dotted path with numeric array indices, such as transactions.3.amount. A required error names the missing property. An empty string means the schema as a whole.

formats_unchecked.description: Sorted format names the schema uses that core does not assert. Core asserts only date and date-time.

output_paradigm.description: Which paradigm(s) the raw output was, before normalization. Lets consumers reason about what is native vs derived.

document.description: Doc-level results. At least one of {markdown, text, typed_fields, pages[].blocks} MUST be populated (see anyOf below) — that is the honest common denominator across P1..P6.

markdown.description: Full-document markdown export. Native for P1/P4; assembled from blocks for P3/P5; from tokens for P6; IMPOSSIBLE for pure P2 extractors with no text (Sensible) → absent. C3 markdown.gfm.

text.description: Full-document plain text in reading order. Same availability as markdown. C1 text.plain + C2 text.complete.

description.description: e.g. Textract Lending PageType '1005', DocAI classifier label.

width.description: In page.unit; needed to de-normalize bbox.

unit.description: The unit width/height are in. Azure reports inch (PDF) or pixel (image); pdf libs report pdf_point; OCR reports pixel@dpi.

markdown.description: Per-page markdown (LlamaParse, Mistral, MinerU). C3 markdown.gfm.

text.description: C1 text.plain + C2 text.complete (scope rule: covers pages[].text too).

blocks.description: THE COMMON SPINE. Reading-order typed blocks. Empty [] for pure typed-field APIs and un-prompted token-stream LLMs (honest: not a failure, a structural absence).

confidence.description: Page-level confidence when the backend gives one (Mistral page granularity, Docling page confidence report, camelot per-table). C7 confidence.unit: float in [0,1].

image_base64.description: Rendered page image when requested/returned (Chunkr pages[].image is a presigned URL → normalizer MAY inline or keep url).

source_backend.description: the backend that produced this page (page-granularity escalation).

confidence.description: Document-level confidence in [0,1] (C7). The honest home for document-scope signals (open-ocr overall scalar, nuextract outputTokenProbability, docling overall ConfidenceScores) — these must NOT be smeared onto per-block confidence.

typed_fields.description: Optional. Present for P2 extractors and P6 user-schema extraction. A map keyed by field name; each value normalized to a common Field shape. Absent for pure parsers (pymupdf, docling, unstructured, marker, OCR engines) — they extract structure, not fields. §4.6: values keep native JSON types (no str() coercion); repeated field names collect into a list value; TypedField.citations is populated when the provider returns per-field geometry.

value.description: string | number | boolean | null | nested object | array (Mindee SimpleField/ObjectField/ListField collapse into this).

normalized_value.description: Backend's normalized form where present (Textract AnalyzeID NormalizedValue, DocAI normalizedValue{dateValue,moneyValue}).

confidence.description: Numeric [0,1] where numeric (Chunkr/Reducto/DocAI); qualitative enum preserved as string where the backend is qualitative (Mindee Certain/High/Medium; Sensible confident_answer/...).

citations.description: Per-field source grounding (Reducto /extract citations, Chunkr Citation leaves, Claude page_location).

chunks.description: Optional. RAG chunks when requested and supported natively (Reducto chunks, Chunkr chunks, unstructured CompositeElement, LlamaIndex nodes, Docling chunker). Otherwise the router may derive from blocks.

usage.description: Normalized usage: what a backend consumed, in the units it reported. Fields are per-backend-natural and the router fills only what the backend left unset. No money. cost_usd and cost_basis were removed because they were computed from a per-vendor price table this package kept in its own source and could not verify. Multiply these counters by the prices on your own invoice.

job.description: Async job handle when applicable (Textract JobId, LlamaParse pjb-..., Chunkr task_id, Reducto job_id).

warnings.description: Requested-but-unsupported outputs/features, degradations, coordinate-conversion notes. E.g. 'typed_fields requested but backend is a parser; empty', 'confidence unavailable for deterministic parser', 'bbox omitted: markdown-only tier'. C6 channels.deliver-or-warn: a requested channel graded N or D is populated OR a machine-readable warning names it. Warning codes are an OPEN set; known codes include page_attribution_unavailable (§4.3 container rule: page-unattributable derived blocks live in one synthetic Page(page_number=1) and the adapter emits this warning); critical_field_missing and critical_field_invalid (a critical path in field) and intent_all_critical (every labelled field is critical), added by the schema check.

backend_raw.description: The untouched native payload (hosted JSON) or the serialized native object (library) — see §5. Present when outputs.include_backend_raw=true. This is the escape hatch that makes lossy normalization safe: nothing the backend produced is ever destroyed.

payload.description: The raw value, or a reference handle when too large to inline.

object_class.description: For serialized native objects: fully-qualified class, e.g. 'fitz.Page.get_text.dict', 'docling_core.types.doc.DoclingDocument', 'unstructured...Element'.

orchestration.description: Strategy execution trace (present only for strategy-engaged runs): strategy, config_hash, chosen_backend, fallback_depth, outcome, attempts[], decisions[], dropped[].

channel_provenance.description: Per-response provenance for mode-dependent adapters (qwen markdown-mode vs html-mode; azure default vs text-format mode): maps a channel name to whether THIS response's value was backend-native or platform-derived (§3.3). Static descriptor grades cannot express mode-dependent provenance; this can. x-stability: experimental — excluded from backward-compat guarantees until promoted to stable.

schema_url.description: The $id URL of the schema version this response declares (OTel schema_url pattern). Optional; when present it equals this file's $id for the declared schema_version.

description: v0.4 (Schema check): additive over v0.3. Adds the optional top-level schema_check object, which reports how the returned typed_fields measure up against the request's extraction_schema.json_schema, field by field. It is present whenever the request carried extraction_schema.json_schema and a response was returned, succeeded or partial. A request without extraction_schema gets no schema_check. Every other field matches v0.3, and so does the channel contract: C1 text.plain, C2 text.complete, C3 markdown.gfm, C6 channels.deliver-or-warn, C7 confidence.unit [0,1], C8 bbox.canonical, C9 page.provenance, C10 status.honest, C11 text-blocks.coherent. STABILITY: invariants C1-C11 are enforced progressively during v0.5 development and are hard guarantees as of the v0.5 package release.
